en.title: The grandfather who came back from the sea
en.body:
My grandfather on my mother's side was a Galician merchant sailor. He had come north with my grandmother when they were young, to build a life, and there they raised four daughters; the eldest was my mother. In my memory his figure is a coming and going: long absences and long returns.

What I keep is the moustache, the hoarse voice and the smile. I do not remember ever seeing him in a bad mood. He died on 22 February 2025.

es.title: El abuelo que volvía de la mar
es.body:
Mi abuelo materno era marino mercante y gallego. Se había venido al norte con la abuela, muy joven, a hacer una vida, y allí criaron a cuatro hijas; la mayor era mi madre. En mi memoria su figura es un ir y venir: largas ausencias y regresos, largos también.

Lo que guardo es el bigote, la voz ronca y la sonrisa. No recuerdo haberle visto nunca de mal humor. Murió el 22 de febrero de 2025.
